work.author: Augustine of Hippo
work.description: Augustine's four books reconciling the four Gospel narratives. Book III treats the Passion and Resurrection and is the traditional Latin authority for holding that the four evangelists narrate one sequence of events; this repository reads it for that claim rather than for chronology in years, which it does not give.
work.title: De consensu evangelistarum
